description: Keep recordings, transcripts and action items from Zoom, Google Meet, Telemost and Jitsi calls together. Record and transcribe Russian speech on a Linux x64 or arm64 host with Chrome, Xvfb, PulseAudio, ffmpeg and the separately installed GigaAM plugin or your own transcription server. Use five built-in or custom summary templates, transcript search, timecoded Q&A, optional calendar auto-join and external agents through MCP or REST. A BB agent or an optional model API writes summaries; calendar sync needs Google OAuth or an ICS feed, and admission can require a platform account.
